# Import and tidy up data
```{r import raw data}
# prolific batch 1 (n=5), batch 2 (n=130), batch 3 (n=68), batch 4 (n=23)
batch1 <- read_csv("./data/exp-4/00.exp4-raw-batch1.csv")%>%mutate(batch=1)
batch1_attnchecks <- read_csv("./data/exp-4/01.exp4-attnchecks-batch1.csv")%>%mutate(batch=1)

# bind all
data <- rbind(batch1)
attn_checks <- rbind(batch1_attnchecks)
```


```{r apply inclusion criteria}
# set up trial names, create and select relevant columns
L_data <- data%>%
  mutate(data_type="within subjects",
         manipulation_type = case_when(str_detect(trial_condition, "1 agent,")==TRUE ~ "baseline",
                                       str_detect(trial_condition, "attention_checks")==TRUE ~ "attention_checks",
                                 TRUE ~ "main"),
         A_intentionality=case_when(str_detect(trial_condition, "intentional")==TRUE ~ "intentional drop",
                                       str_detect(trial_condition, "no drop")==TRUE ~ "no drop-off",
                                       TRUE ~ "accidental drop"),
         B_intentionality=case_when(str_detect(trial_condition, "pickup")==TRUE ~ "intend to own",
                                         str_detect(trial_condition, "walkaway")==TRUE ~ "no intent to own",
                                       TRUE ~ "Not Applicable"),
         B_knowledge=case_when(str_detect(trial_condition, "aware")==TRUE ~ "knowledgeable",
                                    str_detect(trial_condition, "ignorant")==TRUE ~ "ignorant",
                                    TRUE ~ "Not Applicable"),
         blue_agent_first=case_when(str_detect(agent_order, "A_2,A_1")==TRUE ~ FALSE,
                                       TRUE ~ TRUE))%>%
  select(unique_id,data_type,batch,trial_condition,manipulation_type,A_intentionality,B_intentionality,B_knowledge,
         blue_agent_first, A1_value, A2_value, stmt_1_response, stmt_2_response,
         stmt_3_response, stmt_4_response, stmt_why_response, object_cost_response,id)

# extract object cost judgments
L_data_object_cost <-L_data%>%
  filter(manipulation_type=="attention_checks")%>%
  select(unique_id, object_cost_response)

# add object cost judgments to ownership judgment data
L_data_long <- L_data%>%
  filter(manipulation_type!="attention_checks")%>%
  rename(A=A1_value, B = A2_value)%>%
  gather(agent, value, A,B)%>%
  select(-object_cost_response)%>%
  left_join(L_data_object_cost)%>%
  rename(object_cost = object_cost_response)

L_data_long$object_cost <- as.numeric(L_data_long$object_cost)
L_data_long$value <- as.numeric(L_data_long$value)
L_data_long$agent <- factor(L_data_long$agent, levels=c("A", "B"))

baseline_data<- L_data_long%>%
  filter(manipulation_type=="baseline" & agent=="B")%>% 
  select(-stmt_why_response, -stmt_1_response,-stmt_2_response,-stmt_3_response,-stmt_4_response)%>%
  spread(agent,value)%>%
  spread(trial_condition,B)

baseline_wide <- baseline_data%>%
  group_by(unique_id)%>%
  summarise_all(function(x){x[!is.na(x)]})%>%
  filter(A_intentionality=="accidental drop")

strict_baseline_filter_id <- baseline_wide%>%
  filter(`1 agent,accidental`==0 & `1 agent,intentional`==0 & `1 agent,no drop`==0)

strict_baseline_filtered_data_long <- L_data_long%>%
  filter(unique_id %in% strict_baseline_filter_id$unique_id)

# report inclusion rate
nrow(strict_baseline_filter_id)/nrow(attn_checks) # 57.5% inclusion rate
nrow(attn_checks) - nrow(strict_baseline_filter_id) # 96 excluded participants
```

# Structure the data for further analyses
```{r prepare dataframe for data passed inclusion}
strict_baseline_filtered_data_long$B_intentionality <- factor(strict_baseline_filtered_data_long$B_intentionality,levels = c("Not Applicable", "no intent to own", "intend to own"))
strict_baseline_filtered_data_long$A_intentionality <- factor(strict_baseline_filtered_data_long$A_intentionality,levels = c("no drop-off","accidental drop","intentional drop"))
strict_baseline_filtered_data_long$B_knowledge <- factor(strict_baseline_filtered_data_long$B_knowledge,levels = c("Not Applicable", "knowledgeable","ignorant"))

Main_conditions<-strict_baseline_filtered_data_long%>%
  filter(manipulation_type=="main")%>%
  select(-stmt_why_response, -stmt_1_response,-stmt_2_response,-stmt_3_response,-stmt_4_response)%>%
  spread(agent,value)

Baseline_conditions<-strict_baseline_filtered_data_long%>%
  filter(manipulation_type=="baseline")%>%
  select(-stmt_why_response, -stmt_1_response,-stmt_2_response,-stmt_3_response,-stmt_4_response)%>%
  spread(agent,value)
```

```{r preare dataframe for all data}
L_data_long$B_intentionality <- factor(L_data_long$B_intentionality,levels = c("Not Applicable", "no intent to own", "intend to own"))
L_data_long$A_intentionality <- factor(L_data_long$A_intentionality,levels = c("no drop-off","accidental drop","intentional drop"))
L_data_long$B_knowledge <- factor(L_data_long$B_knowledge,levels = c("Not Applicable", "knowledgeable","ignorant"))

Main_conditions_allData<-L_data_long%>%
  filter(manipulation_type=="main")%>%
  select(-stmt_why_response, -stmt_1_response,-stmt_2_response,-stmt_3_response,-stmt_4_response)%>%
  spread(agent,value)

Baseline_conditions_allData<-L_data_long%>%
  filter(manipulation_type=="baseline")%>%
  select(-stmt_why_response, -stmt_1_response,-stmt_2_response,-stmt_3_response,-stmt_4_response)%>%
  spread(agent,value)
```

```{r get the dataframe ready}
baseline_accidental_agentA <-strict_baseline_filtered_data_long%>%
  filter(manipulation_type=="baseline" & A_intentionality=="accidental drop")%>%
  filter(agent=="A")%>%
  select(unique_id, agent, value)

consequences_data_wide <- strict_baseline_filtered_data_long%>%
  filter(manipulation_type=="main")%>%
  rename(use=stmt_1_response, dispose=stmt_2_response, alter=stmt_3_response, lend=stmt_4_response)%>%
  select(unique_id, trial_condition, trial_condition,manipulation_type, A_intentionality, B_knowledge, 
         use, dispose, alter, lend, stmt_why_response)%>%
  distinct()%>%
  mutate(trial_condition_no = factor(trial_condition))%>%
  left_join(baseline_accidental_agentA)

consequences_data_long <- consequences_data_wide%>%
  select(-stmt_why_response)%>%
  gather(statement_type, statement_response, use, dispose, alter, lend)%>%
  mutate(statement_type = factor(statement_type, levels = c("use", "dispose", "alter", "lend")),
         response_numeric = case_when(statement_response == "Yes" ~ 1, 
                                      TRUE ~ 0),
         statement_response = factor(statement_response, levels=c("No","Yes")))
```

```{r get the dataframe ready for all data (incl excluded participants)}
baseline_accidental_agentA_allData <-L_data_long%>%
  filter(manipulation_type=="baseline" & A_intentionality=="accidental drop")%>%
  filter(agent=="A")%>%
  select(unique_id, agent, value)

consequences_data_wide_allData <-  L_data_long%>%
  filter(manipulation_type=="main")%>%
  rename(use=stmt_1_response, dispose=stmt_2_response, alter=stmt_3_response, lend=stmt_4_response)%>%
  select(unique_id, trial_condition, trial_condition,manipulation_type, A_intentionality, B_knowledge, 
         use, dispose, alter, lend, stmt_why_response)%>%
  distinct()%>%
  mutate(trial_condition_no = factor(trial_condition))%>%
  left_join(baseline_accidental_agentA_allData)

consequences_data_long_allData <- consequences_data_wide_allData%>%
  select(-stmt_why_response)%>%
  gather(statement_type, statement_response, use, dispose, alter, lend)%>%
  mutate(statement_type = factor(statement_type, levels = c("use", "dispose", "alter", "lend")),
         response_numeric = case_when(statement_response == "Yes" ~ 1, 
                                      TRUE ~ 0),
         statement_response = factor(statement_response, levels=c("No","Yes")))
```

# exploratory analysis: figuring out why exclusion rate is high
```{r visual and t-tests for excluded participants (SI)}
# Total exclude based on the strict inclusion criteria: 96
# visual: excluded participants' original owner ownership rating
L_data_long%>%
  filter(!unique_id %in% strict_baseline_filter_id$unique_id)%>%
  filter(manipulation_type=="baseline" & agent=="B")%>%
  mutate(A_intentionality=factor(A_intentionality, levels=c("no drop-off",
                                                           "accidental drop",
                                                           "intentional drop")))%>%
  ggplot(aes(agent,value))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  geom_point(alpha=.3)+
  facet_grid(~A_intentionality)+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x= element_blank())+
  ylab("Ownership rating") + xlab("Second agent")

# percentage 
L_data_long%>%
  filter(!unique_id %in% strict_baseline_filter_id$unique_id)%>%
  filter(manipulation_type=="baseline" & agent=="B")%>%
  group_by(A_intentionality)%>%
  summarise(sum(value==0)/96)

# mean
L_data_long%>%
  filter(!unique_id %in% strict_baseline_filter_id$unique_id)%>%
  filter(manipulation_type=="baseline" & agent=="B")%>%
  group_by(A_intentionality)%>%
  summarise(mean=mean(value),
            sd=sd(value))

# t-tests
B_nodrop_excluded <- Baseline_conditions_allData%>%filter(!unique_id %in% strict_baseline_filter_id$unique_id)%>%filter(A_intentionality=="no drop-off")%>%select(B)
B_accidental_excluded <- Baseline_conditions_allData%>%filter(!unique_id %in% strict_baseline_filter_id$unique_id)%>%filter(A_intentionality=="accidental drop")%>%select(B)
B_intentional_excluded <- Baseline_conditions_allData%>%filter(!unique_id %in% strict_baseline_filter_id$unique_id)%>%filter(A_intentionality=="intentional drop")%>%select(B)

t.test(B_accidental_excluded$B,B_nodrop_excluded$B,  paired = TRUE)
t.test(B_intentional_excluded$B, B_accidental_excluded$B, paired = TRUE)
```

# Ownership consequences analyses
## H1:
```{r permissibility judgments ~ agent A ownership rating}
model_consequence_1 <- glmer(statement_response ~ value + (1+value|statement_type)+(1+value|unique_id), data=consequences_data_long,family=binomial, control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))

summary(model_consequence_1)
```

```{r logistic mixed-effects regression prediction action permissibility with (SI) Table. 24}
tab_model(model_consequence_1, 
          show.ci = F, show.stat = T, show.est = T,
          p.style = "numeric_stars",
          string.stat = "t value", 
          dv.labels = c("Original owner ownership rating"))
```

## H1: (for all data, including excluded participants)
```{r permissibility judgments ~ agent A ownership rating for all data}
model_consequence_1_allData <- glmer(statement_response ~ value + (1+value|statement_type)+(1+value|unique_id), data=consequences_data_long_allData,family=binomial, control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))

summary(model_consequence_1_allData)
```

```{r logistic mixed-effects regression prediction action permissibility for all data with (SI) Table. 25}
tab_model(model_consequence_1_allData, 
          show.ci = F, show.stat = T, show.est = T,
          p.style = "numeric_stars",
          string.stat = "t value", 
          dv.labels = c("Original owner ownership rating"))
```

# Ownerhip theories for Exp. 3 and 4 for written responses
## Voronoi partition
```{r export exp. 4 data}
#write_csv(Baseline_conditions, "./data/exp-4/02.exp4-baseline-conditions.csv")
```

```{r import assigned Voronoi group to participants}
# read in voronoi data
data_voronoi <- read_csv("./data/exp-3/04.exp3-main-conditions-voronoi.csv")
data_voronoi_baseline <- read_csv("./data/exp-3and4/01.exp3and4-baseline-conditions-voronoi.csv")
all_voronoi <- rbind(data_voronoi, data_voronoi_baseline)

exp3_all_voronoi <- all_voronoi%>%filter(unique_id %in% data_voronoi$unique_id)
exp4_baseline_voronoi <- data_voronoi_baseline%>%filter(unique_id %in% strict_baseline_filter_id$unique_id)
```

## Exp. 3 & 4 – Mentalistic theory and physical possession theory scoring
### Exp. 3
```{r scoring}
toCluster_data_prep1<- exp3_all_voronoi %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  filter(A_intentionality=="accidental drop")%>%
  select(unique_id, trial_condition, A_intentionality, B_intentionality, which_Voronoi_group)

# mentalistic
mentalistic_score <- toCluster_data_prep1%>%
  group_by(unique_id)%>%
  summarise(score = sum(which_Voronoi_group==2))%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  mutate(score_type = "mentalistic")

# non-mentalistic
B_intend_to_own_score <- toCluster_data_prep1%>%
  filter(B_intentionality=="intend to own")%>%
  mutate(B_intend_to_own_score = case_when(which_Voronoi_group==4 ~ 1,
                                           TRUE ~ 0))%>%
  select(unique_id,B_intend_to_own_score)%>%
  group_by(unique_id)%>%
  summarise(B_intentional_score = sum(B_intend_to_own_score))%>%
  ungroup()

B_no_intent_to_own_score <- toCluster_data_prep1%>%
  filter(B_intentionality=="no intent to own" | B_intentionality=="Not Applicable")%>%
  mutate(B_no_intent_score = case_when(which_Voronoi_group==1 ~ 1,
                                           TRUE ~ 0))%>%
  select(unique_id,B_no_intent_score)%>%
  group_by(unique_id)%>%
  summarise(B_unintentional_score = sum(B_no_intent_score))%>%
  ungroup()

non_mentalistic_score <- B_intend_to_own_score%>%
  left_join(B_no_intent_to_own_score)%>%
  mutate(score=B_intentional_score + B_unintentional_score)%>%
  select(unique_id,score)%>%
  mutate(score_type = "non-mentalistic")
  
exp3_subj_theory_score_long <- mentalistic_score%>%rbind(non_mentalistic_score)

exp3_subj_theory_score_wide <- exp3_subj_theory_score_long%>%
  spread(score_type,score)
```

### Exp. 4
```{r scoring}
exp4_toCluster_data_prep1<- exp4_baseline_voronoi %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  filter(A_intentionality=="accidental drop")%>%
  select(unique_id, trial_condition, A_intentionality, B_intentionality, which_Voronoi_group)

# mentalistic
exp4_mentalistic_score <- exp4_toCluster_data_prep1%>%
  group_by(unique_id)%>%
  summarise(score = sum(which_Voronoi_group==2))%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  mutate(score_type = "mentalistic")

# non-mentalistic
exp4_non_mentalistic_score <- exp4_toCluster_data_prep1%>%
  group_by(unique_id)%>%
  summarise(score = sum(which_Voronoi_group==1))%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  mutate(score_type = "non-mentalistic")
  
exp4_subj_theory_score_long <- exp4_mentalistic_score%>%rbind(exp4_non_mentalistic_score)

exp4_subj_theory_score_wide <- exp4_subj_theory_score_long%>%
  spread(score_type,score)
```

## Assign intuitive theory group
```{r exp. 3 & 4 - decide which intuitive theory a participant have}
## exp. 3
exp3_quantify_subj_theory <- exp3_subj_theory_score_wide%>%
  mutate(which_theory = case_when(mentalistic>`non-mentalistic` ~ "mentalistic theory",
                                  mentalistic<`non-mentalistic` ~ "non-mentalistic theory",
                                  TRUE ~ "uncertain"),
         mentalistic_freq = mentalistic/5,
         nonmentalistic_freq = `non-mentalistic`/5)%>%
  select(unique_id, which_theory)

exp3_quantify_subj_theory%>%
  group_by(which_theory)%>%
  summarise(n()/130)

## exp. 4
exp4_quantify_subj_theory <- exp4_subj_theory_score_wide%>%
  mutate(which_theory = case_when(mentalistic>`non-mentalistic` ~ "mentalistic theory",
                                  mentalistic<`non-mentalistic` ~ "non-mentalistic theory",
                                  TRUE ~ "uncertain"),
         mentalistic_freq = mentalistic/1,
         nonmentalistic_freq = `non-mentalistic`/1)%>%
  select(unique_id, which_theory)

exp4_quantify_subj_theory%>%
  group_by(which_theory)%>%
  summarise(n()/130)

## exp. 3 and 4
exp3_quantify_subj_theory%>%
  rbind(exp4_quantify_subj_theory)%>%
  group_by(which_theory)%>%
  summarise(n()/260)

quantify_subj_theory <- rbind(exp3_quantify_subj_theory, exp4_quantify_subj_theory)

# write out for written response comparison
#write_csv(quantify_subj_theory, "./data/exp-4/02.exp3and4-ownership-theory.csv")
```
